post.title: Amazon's real profit machine isn't the store
post.ig:
Most of Amazon's profit doesn't come from selling you stuff.
In 2025, AWS, its cloud arm, was 18% of Amazon's $716.9 billion in sales but 57% of operating profit.
AWS: $45.6 billion in operating profit. The whole store side: about $34.4 billion.
Per $100 of sales, AWS kept about $35. The store kept about $6.
Sources: Amazon 2025 Form 10-K and earnings releases.
